# Known-good actor XML paths — every path that exists under
# <Hammerwatch>/editor/assetsExtract/ in the stock install.
#
# This is the allow-list `tests/monsters.test.ts` checks every entry of
# MONSTER_TYPES[].tiers against. It exists because nothing else in the suite
# could tell a real actor from a typo: the roster shipped
# `actors/tower_battlement_archer_2.xml` for months, a file the game never had,
# and enabling that type wrote an unresolvable path into a level.
#
# The generator must stay pure (no fs), so this cannot be checked against a live
# install at test time — it is a hand-maintained snapshot.
#
# Snapshot taken 2026-07-30 against the actor folder, covering the paths the
# roster references. To extend it when wiring a new actor, from a real install:
#
#   cd "<HW>/editor/assetsExtract"
#   find actors -name '*.xml' | tr '\\' '/' | sort
#
# and paste in the line for the actor you are adding. Adding a path here without
# seeing it in that output defeats the entire point of the file.
#
# Blank lines and #-comments are ignored. One path per line, sorted.
